_meta.notes: Compiled from Claude training knowledge (Wikipedia EN+ID, BPS Sensus Penduduk 2020, government sources through 2024). Population estimates are 2020 census baseline or most recent known estimate; marked 'unknown' where uncertain. Coordinates accurate to ~2 decimal places (settlement/administrative centre). Post-2022 Papua restructure included (Papua Selatan, Papua Tengah, Papua Pegunungan, Papua Barat Daya). Not fabricated: entries below the reliable-recall threshold were omitted. Confidence over completeness. Kind classification: 'kota' = autonomous city, 'kabupaten' = regency, 'kecamatan' = district, 'unknown' = uncertain. Provinces ordered by region groupings. Bali locations listed first in cities array to support seed rotation.
